name: walk_limp
text: A person walks forward with a pronounced limp on the right leg. The injured right knee stays slightly bent, quickly take weight off the right foot, then linger on the good left leg. Uneven short right steps and longer left steps, asymmetrical bobbing of the torso. Both arms balance naturally. Keep advancing straight without stopping or turning.

trim.reason: Select the reviewed complete middle cycle, avoiding start/end settling.

review.notes_zh: 右腿屈膝短步、快速移开承重，左腿步幅更大；左右脚近乎静止的支撑时长约37%和43%，有可辨认的不对称步态。无拐杖。
